about: Task 13, the richer-truth audit. Simulation only. Today's model (B0) against Fisher's two-reactant chlorine-organics chemistry in EPANET-MSX (2RA) and the committed first-order truth, paired on the same fresh seeds and draws. Every number is computed from the CSVs named in 'sources' as written.

definitions.B0: today's model: SimGP24 on the committed 675-member grid, committed settings (simgp24 in results_time)
definitions.rmse, mae, coverage: means over seeds of per-seed daily-minimum values at unsampled junctions (as committed)
definitions.recall, precision, F1, false_alarms: pooled counts over seeds (found of low junction-days; a seed with no low junction adds nothing); recall_mean_of_seeds is the committed convention (1.0 for a seed with nothing to find)
definitions.oracle: best single member and dose against the full daytime truth, daily minimum at every junction
definitions.lowkb: B0 on simgp.GRIDS['full_lowkb'] (bulk rates 0.0125 to 0.70 per day), an opt-in variant

age_deciles.bins: deciles of the operator's nominal daily-mean age (task 9's bins; 1 = youngest)

rule.bar: 2RA truth, B0, 8 demo samples, pooled oldest decile: |bias| > 0.05 mg/L is recorded as the first-order limit and the next step is named, not built

near_threshold_no_bar.about: added after the review, no bar: every junction's true daily minimum (all junctions, 8 seeds) by band in mg/L, [lo, hi); a map biased low flags junction-days just above 0.2

materiality.bar: material if, at n = 8 or 15 under the random or straddle_min rule, on Net3 or Net2 (24 h match), B0's 2RA-truth daily-minimum RMSE is above 1.10 x, or its pooled recall below 0.90 x, the paired first-order truth's (point ratios; intervals reported)
triggered: Net2 straddle_min n=15 rmse: 1.102 (0.838 to 1.463), within seed noise
materiality.reading: material: the gated two-rate model is built

age_decile.bar: 2RA truth, B0, 8 demo samples, pooled oldest decile: |bias| > 0.05 mg/L is recorded as the first-order limit and the next step is named, not built

lowkb_recommendation.reading: a candidate for the default grid; adopting it would move committed numbers, which is Devansh's decision
